title: E-FRC-0064: the derived Koide relation Q = 2/3 predicts the tau mass 1776.97 MeV from the electron and muon alone...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0064 in the gauge arena: the derived Koide relation Q = 2/3 predicts the tau mass 1776.97 MeV from the electron and muon alone, matching the measured 1776.86 to about one part in ten thousand, a sharp falsifiable number where the Standard Model leaves the tau mass free.
known_limitations: Depth L1 (L1: known mathematics, correctly confirmed).
